what: Creator with a community of 350,000+ announces leaving Patreon, reporting nearly a year of contract negotiations in which Patreon allegedly attempted to control the creator's book release and take credit for the audience.
verbatim_snippet: "Fast forward to almost a YEAR of negotiations they have dicked me around & put things in the contract they sent me that they did not put in any else's contracts they've sent on Patreon (other creators). They essentially are trying to CONTROL MY BOOK RELEASE, and how fkn dare they. They have NO part in my life story. Not only they, they are trying to take credit for why all 350,000 of you are here."
date: Accessed April 2026; page undated. Post ID numbering suggests 2025 publication.
notes: Patreon.com returned 403; passage from Google search index. Creator known as "Do Not Sub." source_type "blog" applied to Patreon creator post — ambiguity noted. Date cannot be precisely fixed within the April 2025–April 2026 window; conservative inclusion based on post ID sequence relative to other dated Patreon posts. The 350,000 figure refers to the creator's total community, not Patreon patrons specifically.
